what: UPSTREAM HOLE in Binance Vision public klines: ALL 60 symbols of the frozen ENTRY universe lack the 24 hourly bars of 2026-10-28 (00:00-23:00 UTC). MEASURED 2026-11-06 (ml-entry-retrain mode=gaps, runs 42253232250 and 42254532292): BTCUSDT's own monthly 2026-10 archive has 720 bars (744 expected) with an internal gap 10-27 23:00 -> 10-29 00:00, and the DAILY file for 2026-10-28 is 404. Not our fetch. A decision row needs 24 contiguous forward bars (ml_decision_entry.label_symbol), so the hole removes the decision rows of 10-27 and 10-28 for every symbol; that is why the retrain candidate's train_end was 10-26 23:00Z, not the 10-28 23:00Z plan bound, and it costs the grader about 2 of 14 days of window n (candidate n 281 vs the 300 floor; ~328 expected without the hole is an ESTIMATE, not measured). No free backfill: fapi.binance.com returns 451 (restricted location) from GitHub runners and fapi1-3 return empty 202. The label code correctly DROPS the spanning decisions rather than faking bars; nothing to fix in the pull. Self-healing: training catches up once the plan bound passes 10-29 (the 2026-11-08 run), and a 14-day grading window clears the hole for run dates from 2026-11-12.
